description: Square 6x6 inch terracotta tile from Pak Clay for floors and walls. The small square suits kitchens, stair risers, narrow passages and traditional-look rooms where extra grout lines are part of the style. Fired clay gives a warm colour with natural shade variation between pieces. Clay is porous, so use a sound base and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Small tiles need more pieces per square foot, so order extra from one batch for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta square floor tile, 9x9 inch, from Pak Clay. The mid-size square sits between small traditional tiles and large formats, giving a balanced look in verandas, living areas and kitchens. Fired clay has a warm, earthy colour with slight shade differences that add character. Prepare a level base, ask your fixer about sealing since clay is porous, and order everything from one batch with a margin for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Terracotta star and cross tile, 10x5 inch, from Pak Clay for floors. The interlocking star and cross shapes form a traditional repeating pattern that suits verandas, courtyards and heritage-style rooms. Fired clay gives a warm colour with natural shade variation. Patterned layouts use more tile for cuts, so order extra from one batch. Clay is porous, so ask your fixer about a breathable sealer and suitable adhesive. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Multi-colour diamond-shape otti tile from Pak Clay. Otti tiles are laid in colourful patterns, and the diamond shape gives a lively, geometric layout for paths, porches and outdoor floors. Shades vary between pieces, so view a sample and plan the pattern before fixing. Prepare a firm, sloped base for drainage and ask your fixer about the right bedding. Order the full quantity from one batch with a margin for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
